messages:
Ali (AE): Heads up — AtlasHealth asking for a mid-contract price alignment. They want to expand committed capacity from 2M -> 4M tokens/month and want pricing to reflect that. Can we get guidance before I present numbers?

Megan (CSM): They're also asking for a 60-day POC extension and want embeddings + reranking added to the trial scope. Security questionnaire still outstanding — InfoSec asked for our network diagram and data residency confirmation.

Emma (SalesOps): @Ali I pulled the list tiers: current 2M = $0.005/token, 4M = $0.004/token (list). If they want a blended they are asking in the ~$0.0038/token range. Anything >20% off list needs Deal Desk approval.

Ali (AE): Customer is pushing for parity with competitor X. They proposed ~24% off list blended. That exceeds standard concession caps — need pre-approval or an alternative structuring suggestion.

Hank (Legal): Any contract ask beyond price? They asked for SOC2 evidence, stricter SLA targets, SSO + SCIM, and custom indemnity language. Indemnity change is a legal escalation if they insist.

Nate (Eng): For Dedicated: latency SLO target 120ms p95 — doable with a dedicated pool but we'd need ~2 weeks to reserve nodes and configure. POC extension OK but we should cap burst to avoid surprise spend.

Megan (CSM): Note: Adding embeddings/rerank changes compute profile — might shift model recommendation to a smaller-quantized variant for cost efficiency. I'll capture workload examples from the customer.

Emma (SalesOps): Deal Desk path: submit Request Form + commercial justification. Approvals needed for >20%: AE, Head of Sales, Finance. I can draft the justification. Suggested concession structure that limits ARR hit: upfront credit + adjusted per-token rate.

Ali (AE): Draft justification I'm planning to submit: "Customer doubles committed units (2M->4M), multi-product POC extension (embeddings + rerank), 12-month term. Requesting blended rate ~ $0.0039/token (~24% off list) to win and retain strategic healthcare account." Will open the form now.

Hank (Legal): Please upload the completed security questionnaire to the legal folder before we sign. Link?

Megan (CSM): Uploaded SQ + network diagram and data flow to https://redwood.internal/sq/atlas-2026. @Hank please confirm if that's sufficient or if InfoSec needs more detail.

Hank (Legal): I'll review now. If they push on custom indemnity or data residency amendments we'll need Legal + Security call. Flagging possible escalation.

Emma (SalesOps): Proposed numeric concession (example to include in Request Form):
```
Upfront credit = $12,000
Adjusted rate = $0.0039/token for 12 months
Commit = 4M tokens/month (12-month term)
```
This keeps ARR visible while limiting cash flow exposure.

Ali (AE): If Deal Desk approves, convert POC consumption to committed credits on day 1. Also propose a 30-day performance-based rollback clause if latency/quality targets not met. Would that be acceptable?

Nate (Eng): Rollback clause is fine — we can implement an automated canary fallback to hosted variants and monitor SLOs. Need to add a 2-week provisioning buffer into timeline.

Ali (AE): Next steps: I will file the Deal Desk Request (with Emma's numbers), Megan to confirm SQ completeness, Hank to flag legal blockers by EOD Wednesday. If Deal Desk declines >20% concession, propose a scaled pilot with a smaller discount instead. :crossed_fingers: 

Megan (CSM): +1 — I'll coordinate CS handoff and collect infra/logging asks from the customer.

Emma (SalesOps): Form is ready to go. Ping me when you submit; I'll queue it for review.

deploy-bot: DealDeskRequest created: DD-2026-8745 (status: queued)

Ali (AE): Thanks team — customer timeline: wants contract signed by Apr 10. We need review and answers ASAP.
